name: eBay listing: 32x NVIDIA A100 40GB AI inferencing rack (Core 4 Solutions IT Hardware)
notes: Live listing read 2026-10-03, item 178522410497. Title: '*AI Inferencing Rack* 32x NVIDIA A100 40GB GPU Compute Node Rack'. Asking price US $249,000.00 or Best Offer. Seller condition text: 'Listing is for one rack. Each Rack includes 4x Compute Nodes, each with config below: 8x NVIDIA [A100 40GB]' - i.e. 4 nodes x 8 GPUs = 32 GPUs per rack. Quantity 'More than 10 available', so this is a repeated-lot liquidation channel rather than a one-off. Located Minneapolis, Minnesota. Free FedEx Ground, free local pickup over 60 mi. Seller does not accept returns. Seller feedback score 20,700. This is the single most decision-relevant number in the slice: $7,781 per A100 40GB on a full-rack basis including the servers, versus ~$2,500-$3,000 for a bare used A100 40GB SXM4 module on the same site.
